title: 第17章 夜袭第18章 握手与暗流
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
当夜，月黑风高。
罗恩带着劳恩、格雷，还有两个骑士扈从，从庄园后门悄悄出去。
每个人都换了旧皮甲，蒙了黑布，武器也是从库房里翻出来的普通货色，没有任何标记。
“记住，”
罗恩压低声音：
“动手的时候，不要说话。万一有人跑掉，不要追。得手就撤，天亮之前必须回来。”
众人点头。
一行人绕开所有巡逻路线，往西边浅滩摸去，好在所有人都是骑士，运转斗气，夜晚的荒野并没有造成很大影响。
与此同时，临水领北边，鲍里斯男爵也趁着夜色出发了。他们同样换了装束，从另一条路绕过浅滩，往东边摸去。
夜色里，两股人马，朝着各自的方向，擦肩而过。
谁也不知道对方的存在。
罗恩带人过了浅滩，沿着河岸往北摸。好在有绿湖领男爵给的地图，罗恩一行人畅通无阻。
摸了两里地，看见了火光。
一处简易的木栅栏围成的小营地，里面立着三四顶帐篷，火堆还燃着，几个人围坐在一起喝酒。瞭望台上站着个人，正往河对岸的方向张望。
罗恩打了个手势。众人绕过哨塔继续前进。
一个小时后，终于抵达了临水领的一个村庄。
罗恩伏在草丛里观察了片刻，塔上有两个守夜的士兵。
打了个手势，瞭望台上两人还没反应过来，劳恩的箭已经射穿了他们的喉咙。
“上！”
罗恩一马当先，运转斗气，直接翻过了两米多高的围墙，冲进营地，打开了大门。

长剑出鞘，斗气在体内疯狂流转。高阶的实力，今晚要彻底展露一次。
农庄响起了慌乱的报警声，有个低阶骑士扈从刚拿起武器冲过来。
剑光闪过，就被罗恩一剑劈飞出去，倒地不起。
其他赶来的士兵脸色大变，转身就跑。
劳恩他们也是见人就杀，整个村庄乱成一团，罗恩没追，只是冷眼看着。旁边那几个农奴早就吓瘫了，跪在地上不敢动弹。
劳恩和格雷冲进粮仓，抢来的火把一扔，干草瞬间烧起来。火光冲天，映红了半边天。
罗恩扫了一眼四周。有些跑掉的士兵已经消失在夜色里，正好。
“撤。”整个袭击过程没有超过十五分钟。
几人放完火后，消失在夜色中。
身后，那个农庄已经乱成一团。有人敲响了警钟，沉闷的钟声在夜空里传出很远。
临走前，罗恩故意留下一件东西，一柄普通的长剑，剑身上什么标记都没有。
但剑柄上缠着的布条，是从河湾领卫兵训练场随便捡的。
罗恩不知道的是，就在他带人袭击临水领的同时，一伙“强盗”已经摸进了河湾领的北边。
他们没有去庄园，而是直奔黑麦屯。
对于鲍里斯男爵来说，河湾领可能拥有高阶骑士扈从，在没有绝对的把握下，他并不想贸然全面对抗。
content_en:
That night, the moon was dark and the wind was high.
Ron took Lawn, Gray, and two knight attendants and quietly went out through the back door of the manor.
Everyone had changed into old leather armor and covered themselves with black cloth, and their weapons were ordinary items found in the warehouse without any markings.
"Remember,"
Ron lowered his voice:
"Don't talk when you take action. If someone runs away, don't chase. If you succeed, retreat. You must be back before dawn."
Everyone nodded.
The group of people bypassed all patrol routes and went to the western shoal. Fortunately, everyone was a knight and running their fighting spirit, so the wilderness at night did not have a big impact.
At the same time, to the north of Linshui Territory, Baron Boris also set out under the cover of night. They also changed their clothes, took another way around the shoal, and headed east.
In the night, two groups of people passed by each other in their respective directions.
Neither one knows the other's existence.
Ron led people across the shoal and walked north along the river bank. Fortunately, with the map given by the Baron of Green Lake, Ron and his party were able to travel smoothly.
After touching the ground for two miles, I saw the light of fire.
There was a small camp surrounded by a simple wooden fence, with three or four tents standing inside. The fire was still burning, and several people were sitting around drinking. There was a man standing on the observation deck, looking across the river.
Ron gestured. Everyone walked around the guard tower and continued moving forward.
An hour later, we finally arrived at a village in Linshui Territory.
Ron lay in the grass and observed for a moment. There were two soldiers keeping watch on the tower.
After making a gesture, before the two people on the observation platform could react, Lawn's arrow had already shot through their throats.
"Up!"
Ron took the lead, using his fighting spirit, he climbed over the two-meter-high wall, rushed into the camp, and opened the gate.
The long sword was unsheathed, and fighting energy circulated crazily in his body. The high-level strength will be fully demonstrated tonight.
A panicked alarm sounded in the farm, and a low-level knight's retinue just picked up a weapon and rushed over.
The sword light flashed, and Ron flew him away with his sword, falling to the ground.
The faces of the other soldiers who came over changed drastically, and they turned around and ran away.
Ron and the others also killed people on sight, and the whole village was in chaos. Ron did not pursue them, but just watched coldly. The serfs next to them were paralyzed with fear and were kneeling on the ground, not daring to move.
Lawn and Gray rushed into the granary and threw the torches they grabbed, causing the hay to burn instantly. The fire soared into the sky, turning half the sky red.
Ron glanced around. Some of the soldiers who ran away had disappeared into the night, just in time.
"Withdraw." The entire attack took less than fifteen minutes.
After several people set the fire, they disappeared into the night.
Behind him, the farm was in chaos. Someone rang the alarm bell, and the dull bell sounded far away in the night sky.
Before leaving, Ron deliberately left something behind, an ordinary long sword with no markings on it.
But the strip of cloth wrapped around the hilt of the sword was randomly picked up from the Hebend Guards Training Ground.
What Ron didn't know was that at the same time that he was leading the attack on the Waterfront Territory, a group of "robbers" had already entered the north of the River Bend Territory.
Instead of going to the manor, they went straight to Rye House.
For Baron Boris, the Riverbend Territory may have high-level knights, but without absolute certainty, he does not want to rush into a full-scale confrontation.
